items.title: Copper edges lower as US inflation data raises bets on Fed rate hike
items.description: Futures on the London Metal Exchange fell as much as 0.6%, following their first weekly decline in since June

items.title: Stock market holiday: BSE, NSE closed today for Ganesh Chaturthi
items.description: The National Stock Exchange (NSE) and the BSE will have no trading or settlement in stocks, derivatives, securities lending and borrowing (SLB) segments on Monday.

items.title: Asian shares slide as oil spike fuels inflation, rate hike concerns
items.description: With shipping through the strait and the Bab el-Mandeb under threat, analysts fear oil prices could stay elevated for a lengthy period, stoking inflation globally
